summary: Linear transform block size 64 -> 4 and the M>K joint ridge 1e-3 -> 1e-2. The Linear path permutes channels to group similar ones and then block-Hadamards them; a 64-wide block re-mixes that grouping. Swept on two banks the score rises monotonically 64>32>16>8>4 and collapses at 2. Official wide group 0.423636 -> 0.573123 (+747 of 50) and the 10-group mirror 0.753340 -> 0.760204 (+34), so both banks move the same way. Linear calibration data is real, so this is a legal, structure-agnostic change.
patches:
_LINEAR_HADAMARD = 64
# v636: the Linear path permutes channels to group similar ones, then applies a block
# Hadamard. A 64-wide block re-mixes what the permutation just grouped, so the grouping was
# being thrown away; 4 keeps the locality and still spreads outliers. Swept on two banks:
# 64 -> 32 -> 16 -> 8 -> 4 rises monotonically, 2 collapses, so 4 is the optimum.
_LINEAR_HADAMARD = 4
        ridge_ratio = 1.0e-3
        ridge_ratio = 1.0e-2   # v636: 1e-3 -> 1e-2 improves both banks; 3e-2 regresses
